messages:
aisha (Finance Ops): FYI Sirocco Labs (SIR-442) is 45 days past due on INV-2024-09-88 for $148,320. No response to two dunning emails. Considering a merchant hold next week unless we get a payment plan today.

daniel (Acct Mgmt): Got it. They've been growing fast; I reached out to their finance lead last week but got no reply. Any payment attempts?

billing-bot: Payment status: INV-2024-09-88 \u2014 DUE 45d \u2014 balance $148,320 \u2014 last_attempt: 2024-11-02T15:03:12Z \u2014 failure_code: R03 (invalid_account) 

kofi (Revenue Ops): Hard hold risks churn. Recommend a 3-installment plan: 25% upfront, 37.5% +30d, 37.5% +60d, with autopay (wire/verified ACH) and acceleration clause on miss.

aisha (Finance Ops): I support 3x. Proposed term draft below. Will not resume provisioning until first payment posts.

--- DRAFT ---
Sirocco Labs \u2014 Payment Plan Proposal
Invoice: INV-2024-09-88
Total: $148,320
Payment schedule:
  - 25% ($37,080) due within 48 hours of acceptance (wire/confirmed ACH)
  - 37.5% ($55,620) due +30 days
  - 37.5% ($55,620) due +60 days
Terms: Missed installment triggers immediate acceleration of full outstanding balance; 15% collection fee and interest at 1.5%/month on overdue amounts. Billable features paused until initial payment posts. Reply to accept or request call within 48 hours.
--- END DRAFT ---

daniel (Acct Mgmt): Language looks fine. Suggest "billable features paused" instead of "services suspended" to keep CS convo smoother.

emily (Legal): "Billable features paused" acceptable. Keep acceleration and collection fee. Add clause: Redwood may seek recovery of reasonable collection costs and attorneys' fees.

aisha (Finance Ops): Updated. I'll send the proposal now and copy Legal.

aisha (Finance Ops): Sent at 2024-11-10T17:12Z. 48h response window. Tagging @kofi to escalate if no reply.

billing-bot: Account note added: \"Payment plan offered 2024-11-10; 48h response window; billable features to be paused pending initial payment.\"

(2024-11-11T09:07Z) sirocco-cfo (external): Thanks for the note. We're aware of the issue. Our treasury team had an ACH block; working to clear. Can we push a 60-day net with milestone review?

kofi (Revenue Ops): Treasury block ok but 60d net is risky. We need immediate skin in the game. Can you confirm 25% wire today and the rest per the schedule?

sirocco-cfo (external): I can authorize a 20% wire today not 25%. The rest we can do 40/40 over 30/60.

aisha (Finance Ops): We need at least 25% to avoid pause. 20% doesn't meet threshold. If they can do 25% now by wire, we'll accept 37.5/37.5.

sirocco-cfo (external): Wire initiated for $37,080 today. Will send confirmation number.

billing-bot: New payment attempt recorded: 2024-11-11T12:34:00Z \u2014 pending (wire).

daniel (Acct Mgmt): Please send wire confirmation to billing@redwood.com and cc me. I'll hold off on pause while we see confirmation.

emily (Legal): Note: once wire clears, prepare amendment with acceleration clause and autopay requirement for remainder. Approve exec sign-off flow.

aisha (Finance Ops): Wire confirmed 2024-11-11T16:02Z (ref WIRE-987654). Posted $37,080. Updating account and preparing contract amendment.

billing-bot: Payment posted: $37,080 on 2024-11-11T16:02:31Z. Remaining balance $111,240.

kofi (Revenue Ops): Good. Draft amendment and send to their CFO for signature. Also flag sales to pause any new enablement until plan is signed.

aisha (Finance Ops): Draft amendment sent 2024-11-11T18:20Z. Terms: 37.5% due 2024-12-11, 37.5% due 2025-01-10; missed payment = acceleration + 15% collection fee + interest; autopay required for remaining installments.

sirocco-cfo (external): Received amendment, routing to legal. Expect signed by 2024-11-13.

last action note: 2024-11-12T09:10Z \u2014 kofi: scheduled call with Sirocco CFO for 2024-11-12T10:00Z to confirm timeline and update leadership.
